name: Expeditious Evaporation
body:
School transmutation [air, water]; Level adept 0, cleric 0, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./ 2 levels)
Targets 1 gallon or less of water
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause a small amount of water to instantly evaporate. The spell may be used to remove water from an object, or to slowly evaporate a body of water. Liquids that are composed primarily of water are dehydrated, leaving behind a dusty residue. Creatures and magical liquids are immune to this effect.
